objective: The coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-26 on the selected direction of LOOK-ALIKE-20261126-001: bound the round at which a start's view (each kind of birth, read without names, counted per round) settles into polynomials, from the start alone, by its largest block: the largest set of live start knots sharing a neighbour, or the largest fresh count of a round-1 birth. Frozen on starts of up to four knots, tested on all five-knot starts (seen before, disclosed) and a seeded sample of six-knot starts (held out), in both readings and both knot laws; with that bound as the cut, the look-alike pair rule tested again. Stop at a start or pair the bound misses, or none.

title: When a local reader's view of a growth settles, from the start alone
